questions.title: Which club will win the Aston Villa–Arsenal Premier League match scheduled for August 31, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Premier League’s official full-time result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from established sports news outlets. Resolution : Resolve after the conclusion of Aston Villa’s home Premier League fixture against Arsenal scheduled for August 31, 2026, using the final score. Accepted Answer Format : Return the winning club’s commonly used name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Who will Ghana appoint to lead the Black Stars for the September–October 2026 international window?
questions.background: The Black Stars are Ghana's senior men's national football team.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Ghana Football Association's official announcement appointing a head coach for the international window running from September 21 to October 6, 2026, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person appointed after August 1, 2026, and before the international window begins, to lead the team during that window. Both interim and permanent appointments qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed coach's full name.

questions.title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
questions.background: The opening goalscorer is the player officially credited with the first goal of the match.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.” Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.

questions.title: Which club will lead the La Liga table immediately after the Valencia–Barcelona match scheduled for September 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official La Liga standings or reputable contemporaneous match reports. Resolution : Resolve to the club occupying first place in the La Liga table immediately after the completion of Valencia's home match against Barcelona scheduled for September 20, 2026. Use the league's official ranking rules if clubs are level on points. Accepted Answer Format : Return the name of the first-placed club.

questions.title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
questions.background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.

questions.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
questions.background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.

questions.title: Which club will win the Premier League match between Aston Villa and Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official Premier League result or reliable contemporaneous match reports for Aston Villa versus Nottingham Forest on September 12, 2026. Resolution : Resolve according to the full-time result, including stoppage time. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name. If the match finishes level, indicate a draw.

questions.title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United. Resolution : Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.

questions.title: Which stadium will UEFA select to host the 2029 men's Champions League final?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 men's Champions League final, or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement. Resolution Date : Resolve when UEFA publicly announces its venue selection. Subsequent venue changes will not alter the answer. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the selected stadium.

questions.title: Which club will win the 2026 Campeones Cup?
questions.background: The Campeones Cup is an annual match between the previous season’s MLS Cup champion and the winner of Mexico’s Campeón de Campeones.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official competition result published by Major League Soccer, supported by reliable match reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the club officially declared the winner of the 2026 Campeones Cup once the match has concluded, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club’s name.

questions.title: Which brand will be Kylian Mbappe’s principal personal sportswear sponsor on September 18, 2026?
questions.background: Kylian Mbappe is a Real Madrid forward with a longstanding individual sponsorship agreement with Nike.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official sponsorship announcements by Mbappe or the sponsoring brand, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the brand holding Mbappe’s principal individual sportswear sponsorship as of September 18, 2026. If no sponsorship change has been announced by that date, resolve to his incumbent sponsor. Club kit suppliers and endorsements outside sportswear do not count. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sportswear brand.

questions.title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage. Resolution : Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

questions.title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
questions.background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport. Resolution : Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins. Accepted Answer Format : The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.

questions.title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
questions.background: The UEFA Nations League is a competition for European national teams.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official match result and contemporaneous reporting of the completed match. Resolution : Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw. Accepted Answer Format : The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.

questions.title: Which national team will win the first UEFA Nations League match between the Republic of Ireland and Israel in September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the first Nations League match between these teams in September 2026. Resolution : Resolve when the match finishes, using the final score. If neither team wins, resolve to a draw. Accepted Answer Format : The winning national team's name, or the result designation if the match is drawn.

questions.title: Which national team will lead UEFA Nations League Group A1 after the matches on September 28, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official group standings or contemporaneous reporting from reputable sports news organizations. Resolution : Identify the national team ranked first in UEFA Nations League Group A1 after all matches played on September 28, 2026, have concluded. Apply UEFA's official tiebreaking rules if teams are level on points. Accepted Answer Format : The country name of the first-placed national team.
